hero.headline: A costed, buildable design from one paragraph.

problem.title: Know what you are building before you fund it.
points: A promising concept is not yet a buildable design.
A cost needs a bill of materials, assumptions and calculations behind it.
Founders and investors need to inspect the model, not accept a black-box answer.
problem.close: The Design Dossier puts the design, costs, drawings, calculations and risk and regulatory register in one live workbook.

steps.title: 1. Send a short brief
steps.text: Use the brief form to describe what you want to build. A paragraph is enough. More detail gives a tighter result. No calls are needed.

steps.title: 2. Anvil builds it from first principles
steps.text: Fractional Forge’s design engine starts with engineering inputs and calculations. It uses open, peer-reviewed engineering libraries and real component pricing. You can fix the budget, footprint or output.

steps.title: 3. A senior engineer reviews it
steps.text: The work is reviewed before you see it. You receive a rigorous first pass in a live Excel workbook, with its assumptions, methods and sources exposed.

get.title: A buildable design
get.text: A system design built around your brief, constraints and required output.

get.title: A costed bill of materials
get.text: The components and quantities behind the design, using real component pricing.

get.title: True cost and a financial model
get.text: The costs behind the design, with assumptions and formulas shown. Change an input and the workbook recalculates.

get.title: Engineering drawings
get.text: Engineering drawings for the proposed design.

get.title: Worked calculations
get.text: The engineering calculations with inputs, formulas, methods and sources shown.

get.title: A risk and regulatory register

examples_intro: Two worked examples show the range. The same engine has also been applied to grid-scale battery storage, vertical farms, CO₂ capture and power-to-liquid aviation fuel.

examples.title: A floating AI data centre
examples.text: A floating AI data centre of about 10 MW, gas-powered and designed with Anvil on a barge. Photoreal renders were produced from the 3D model.
examples.caption: Renders from the 3D model show the barge at sea and the deck.

examples.title: A water-treatment plant
examples.text: Read the worked cost breakdown or open the example package.
examples.caption: A plant render and general-arrangement drawing are available.

trust.title: First principles. Sources shown.
trust.intro: Anvil uses open, peer-reviewed engineering libraries and real component pricing. Every number in the workbook traces back to its inputs, method and source.
points: Examples include PyBaMM for batteries, CoolProp for fluid properties, PandaPower for power networks and IAPWS-IF97 for steam and water.
A senior engineer reviews your Design Dossier before you see it.
You or an investor can change an assumption and see the result recalculate throughout the workbook.
It is a rigorous first pass, not a guarantee. Its assumptions remain visible so they can be checked.
Fractional Forge is run by Tristan Fischer. He worked in project finance at Citigroup and at Shell Technology Ventures, and took a company public on AIM.

steer.title: Fix what cannot move.
steer.text: Set the budget, footprint or required output and Anvil designs around it. Change your mind and it re-solves the design.

price.after_unit: Advisory and fundraising introductions are on a success-fee basis: no raise, no fee.

not_do: Not a black box. Every number traces to an input, method and source.
Not a guarantee. It is a rigorous first pass, reviewed by a senior engineer and made to be checked.
Not locked to the first answer. Change an assumption and the live workbook recalculates.
No calls required. A paragraph through the brief form is enough to begin.

faqs.q: What do I need to send?
faqs.a: A short description through the brief form. One paragraph is enough. Include the output, budget, footprint or other fixed constraints if you know them. More detail produces a tighter result.
You receive the Design Dossier in a few days. A senior engineer reviews it before you see it.

faqs.q: What kinds of hardware are strongest?
faqs.a: The strongest focus lines are battery energy storage, water treatment, electric motor sets and medical assay machines. You can also brief other hardware.
Your first Design Dossier is free. Further work is scoped to your project. Advisory and fundraising introductions are available on a success-fee basis: no raise, no fee.
It is a rigorous first pass, not a guarantee. Anvil works from first principles, uses open engineering libraries and real component pricing, and shows its assumptions so the work can be checked.

faqs.q: How does Design Dossier fit within Fractional Forge?
faqs.a: It is one of four Fractional Forge services run by Tristan Fischer. The others are Condition Desk, Habitat Draft and Bid Check.

cta_line: Send one paragraph. Get a design you can inspect and change. Your first Design Dossier is free.
